hypothesis: Independent oscillator-reset family: in an unchanged closed 4H trend, wait for first 15M Wilder RSI14 recovery from a conventional opposite extreme, plus strict directional candle and previous-bar high/low break. Prior raw breakout/inside/pivot families failed; no variants or outcome-fitted thresholds. Tests recovery timing rather than more breakout geometry.

scanner_sha256.equivalence: Only exact published bytes plus one LF equal exact local bytes; no general whitespace normalization.

rules.RSI: Exactly 180 contiguous closed 15M bars. Deltas of closes 1..14 seed gain/loss with arithmetic means; for every later delta use Wilder (13*previous+current)/14. Both previous and signal RSI from this same 180-bar window. Zero gains AND losses ->50, only zero losses ->100, only zero gains ->0. No forming/future bars, full-history seed or adaptive periods.
rules.confirmation: Immediate LONG transition previous RSI<=30 AND signal RSI>30, close>open AND close>previous high AND signal low<=previous high. SHORT previous RSI>=70 AND signal RSI<70, close<open AND close<previous low AND signal high>=previous low. Do not wait for a later stronger candle after a failed recovery; only a new consecutive below/above-threshold excursion can create a new crossing. No threshold/confirmation relaxation.
rules.trend: Exactly 180 contiguous closed 4H bars. Last close>EMA20>EMA50 LONG or strict inverse SHORT, same EMA implementation. Latest closed 4H as of signal-close time.
rules.stop: Freeze lowest low of last four closed 15M bars INCLUDING signal minus .5 ATR14(15M) LONG, highest high plus .5 ATR SHORT. ATR exactly 180 closed bars. No shrink/widen to fit RR or change to production 4H SL.
rules.target: Freeze fee/slippage-inclusive 2R target at confirmation-close limit price. Require inside prior 179 closed 15M highest high minus .25 ATR LONG / lowest low plus .25 ATR SHORT, excluding signal from room. Nonpositive/invalid target rejects; no future maximum.
rules.identity: rsi-recovery-v1:ticker:direction:previous-candle-time:signal-candle-time. Recovery is immediate on this one transition; no pre-period candidate pricing, outcome evaluation or warmup trading.
rules.pending: Unchanged four-bar frozen limit evaluator. Require prior closed 4H trend match, strict candle color + close beyond frozen previous-bar high/low, last-four-bar touch of frozen level and fixed SL validity. Do not demand a second RSI cross, substitute a newer level/SL/TP or extend expiry.
rules.chronology: signal close+1ms created_ms. Executable bar starts at signal close, signal/prior bars excluded. Unknown fill/any exit on fill bar AMBIGUOUS; later both TP/SL same bar AMBIGUOUS. Missing indicator/window/candle DATA_GAP, halt and retain uncertain cash. Adverse SL gap charged at worse open. Cutoff closed bars only.
rules.missing_state: Incomplete/noncontiguous 180-bar indicator window does not qualify; no reconstructed candidates for missing observation times. Missing executable candle or pending indicator state stops outcome determination. Missing coverage is not a valid zero-trade result.

decision.early_kill: Any complete registered period >=20 resolved with base AvgR<=1e-12 or PF<=1+1e-12: KILL_NO_LIVE_PROMOTION. Stop this model; leave subsequent periods unrun. No variants/retuning.
decision.historical_positive: Both historical_replication periods meeting every selection gate may only be a retrospective research candidate. They are previously viewed under other models; require both untouched future weeks and separately captured-live Shadow. No global optimum or production completion claim.
decision.future_positive: Both future_validation periods separately >=50 resolved and each selection gate; thereafter separate actual-observation Shadow resolved>=20, AvgR>0/PF>1, fee/capital/quality and execution evidence required for any promotion proposal. No automatic promotion.
decision.insufficient: No pooling development, weeks, daily reports, replay or live capture. Insufficient resolved count or partial periods remain INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE; never substitute a tuned variant.
decision.sequential: Process development, historical_replication_1, historical_replication_2, future_validation_1, future_validation_2 in that order. Reproduce original previous ledgers/sources before next period. Do not open next after KILL or quality mismatch.
decision.quality: All source/candle hashes and original first-entry control sets must reproduce. Any mismatch stops with BLOCKED_DATA_QUALITY and metrics/ROI null; no repaired prices/rows or replacing first archive. Indicator unavailable observations remain disclosed; fetch failures block qualification.

limitations: Historical development/replication market data previously viewed; reused research prices are not untouched independent confirmation or live samples.
Many failed hypotheses and correlated market events cause multiple-testing/selection bias; positive historical performance alone cannot prove optimality.
Fixed archived 182-market universe has listing/survivorship bias; disclose missing indicator windows and every market without outcome-based exclusions.
OHLC limit touch is hypothetical; funding, tick, depth, queue, liquidity and actual fills unverified.
Net R uses fee-inclusive stop-risk; MFE/MAE use price stop distance, neither is portfolio ROI.
Fixed research accounts are 10k USDC/1%/max3/total3%/1x/JST daily3%, unchanged. OPEN/AMBIGUOUS/DATA_GAP cash never released to create favorable ROI.
Existing KILL models, pending/VWAP protocols, collectors, production, UI, auth, notifications and account settings remain unchanged.

RSI is an oscillator diagnostic, not a probability or profit guarantee. Conventional thresholds are fixed before outcomes; numerous previously failed families and already viewed markets create selection bias.
